in_marathi.name: Navjot
in_marathi.long_meaning: Navjot हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nav means new and Jot means victory. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is rooted in Hindu mythology.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Navjot একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Nav means new and Jot means victory. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is rooted in Hindu mythology.
